title: AWS Certified AI Practitioner (AIF-C01)
summary: AWS Certified AI Practitioner (AIF-C01) is a foundational certification for people starting with AWS who need to speak about it accurately rather than build on it. The exam is organised into 5 content domains: Fundamentals of AI and ML (20%), Fundamentals of GenAI (24%), Applications of Foundation Models (28%), Guidelines for Responsible AI (14%), Security, Compliance, and Governance for AI Solutions (14%). It is delivered as 50 scored questions and 15 unscored, scored against a scaled pass mark of 700 out of 1,000 with no per-domain minimum, so strength in one domain offsets weakness in another. Every task statement in this topic carries a MEDIUM and a HARD exercise batch, so the practice material follows the published outline of the exam rather than a general reading list. The statements here are taken from the exam guide, and the task list is the one AWS publishes: if AWS revises the guide, this topic is revised with it.
objectives: Fundamentals of AI and ML: the guide's domain 1 focus, examined through its 3 task statement(s).
Fundamentals of GenAI: the guide's domain 2 focus, examined through its 3 task statement(s).
Applications of Foundation Models: the guide's domain 3 focus, examined through its 4 task statement(s).
Guidelines for Responsible AI: the guide's domain 4 focus, examined through its 2 task statement(s).
Security, Compliance, and Governance for AI Solutions: the guide's domain 5 focus, examined through its 2 task statement(s).
